purpose: Independent practice of C2.1 (change vs stay the same).
student_learning_goal: I can name things that change and things that stay the same in my life.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can name things that change and things that stay the same in my life.
header.character_watermark: Bella the Balance Beam Scientist in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.part_title: Part 1: Change or Stay the Same?
parts.student_instructions: Sort each card into CHANGE or STAY THE SAME.
parts.visual_layout: Top of the page. 12 picture/word cards in a 4x3 grid; each labeled with a quantity to sort.

image_placeholders.description: 12 picture/word cards in B&W line-art, 4-row × 3-column grid. Each ~2in × 1.5in. Cards: 'Number of children in class', 'Number of fingers on one hand', 'Days in a week', 'Number of pets at home', 'Sides of a square', 'Weather today', 'Birthday month', 'Number of leaves on tree', 'Number of seasons', 'Cars in parking lot', 'Number of provinces in Canada', 'Temperature outside'. Each card has CHANGE / STAY ovals to circle.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS01_P1_TWELVE_CARDS: keywords (sort, cards) name what the cards ask for.

parts.answer_key: STAY THE SAME: Number of fingers (5), Days in a week (7), Sides of a square (4), Birthday month (yours doesn't change), Number of seasons (4), Number of provinces in Canada (10). CHANGE: Number of children in class, Number of pets at home, Weather today, Number of leaves on tree, Cars in parking lot, Temperature outside.

parts.student_instructions: Name 3 things in YOUR life that CHANGE and 3 things that STAY THE SAME.
parts.visual_layout: Middle. Two columns: CHANGE (3 lines) and STAY THE SAME (3 lines).

image_placeholders.description: A 2-column layout in B&W line-art, ~7in × 3in. Left column titled 'CHANGE' with 3 lined writing rows. Right column titled 'STAY THE SAME' with 3 lined writing rows.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS01_P2_TWO_COLUMNS: keywords (change, same) name what the columns ask for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Accept any plausible: CHANGE — number of friends at recess, number of teeth I have, my mood. STAY — number of legs on a horse, number of letters in my name.

parts.student_instructions: Pick ONE thing that CHANGES from your list. Why does it change? Write a sentence.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of the page. Lined writing area with thinking-bubble icon.

image_placeholders.description: A blank lined writing area in B&W line-art, ~7in × 1.5in. 3-4 dotted lines. Bella thinking-bubble icon top-right.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS01_P3_WHY_BOX: keywords (why) name what the box asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Look for the WHY reasoning — 'because every day is different', 'because some kids are sick', 'because the weather depends on the season'.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, draw a quick picture of one thing in your classroom that STAYS THE SAME.
teacher_notes: Lesson 1 consolidation. Watch Part 1 children who put 'Number of children in class' as STAY — flag for snapshot vs trend reteach. Part 1's 12 cards intentionally include 4 transfer items not seen in the lesson (test of generalisation); Part 3 is a transfer task where children apply the WHY reasoning from the expanded walkthrough to a self-chosen quantity.
